name: band-kungfu
description: Band Kungfu, a browser based voxel crowd brawler with BAND AI spectator play and an optional run analyst.

scripts.lint: eslint src agents test serve.mjs eslint.config.js
scripts.format: prettier --write src agents test serve.mjs index.html package.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json README.md docs .github render.yaml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src agents test serve.mjs index.html package.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json README.md docs .github render.yaml
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
